Marked low confidence: the band is wide because it merges two very different sub-markets.

This row is genuinely bimodal and a single narrow band would be misleading. TOP: global SaaS/enterprise MNC BDR programmes in Bengaluru/Gurugram/Mumbai - Salesforce BDR 0-5 yrs Rs 17.5-19.4L (45 salaries, AmbitionBox high confidence, Aug 2026); Freshworks (NASDAQ-listed) SDR 0-5 yrs Rs 7.1-9.8L (14 salaries). BOTTOM: listed Indian internet and marketplace companies, where the same seniority sits under a BDE/inside-sales title - IndiaMART BDE 0-4 yrs Rs 3.5-3.9L (280 salaries, high confidence, Sep 2026), Info Edge inside sales exec 0-2 yrs Rs 4.0-4.5L (30 salaries, high confidence, Aug 2026), Swiggy BDE Rs 3.3-4.5L, Razorpay BDE Rs 3.6-5.3L. Levels.fyi India shows Business Development median total comp Rs 13.73L with 25th percentile Rs 8.45L and Sales median Rs 14.21L (10 Sep 2026), skewed to exactly these large employers. Rs 22L total high covers an MNC BDR at full attainment plus RSUs. Practical rule for judging an offer: the title on the letter tells you which half you are in - BDR/SDR at a global software company is a 10-19L role, BDE/BDA/inside-sales exec at an Indian listed internet company is a 3.5-5.5L role, at the same age and the same city. Confidence high: multiple large-n, recently-updated sources at both ends.

Anchored on Chennai/Hyderabad/Pune SaaS floors at the top and pan-India marketplace field sales at the bottom. Freshworks (Chennai-headquartered, NASDAQ-listed) SDR 0-5 yrs Rs 7.1-9.8L. IndiaMART, whose BDE force is spread across dozens of non-metro cities, pays Rs 3.5-3.9L for 0-4 yrs (280 salaries, Sep 2026). Large edtech BDA roles, which hire thousands of 0-2 yr people nationally on a fixed-plus-heavy-incentive model, sit between: BYJU'S BDA 0-5 yrs Rs 5.2-5.8L (7,100 salaries) and Unacademy BDA 0-5 yrs Rs 4.6-5.1L (202 salaries) - note these CTCs are typically 60-70% fixed with the balance contingent on collections, so the real fixed floor is nearer Rs 3.5-4L. AmbitionBox city data for Inside Sales Executive: Hyderabad Rs 4.4-4.8L, Pune Rs 4.2-4.6L against Bengaluru Rs 4.4-4.9L. Indeed's all-India BDE base of about Rs 2.5L/yr (2.9k salaries, Sep 2026) marks the genuine bottom. Total high of Rs 13L applies only to a listed-SaaS SDR seat in Chennai/Hyderabad/Pune at full quota. General caveats for the whole table: figures are Indian-rupee CTC as reported in India, never converted from US bands, and entry-level business-side pay here is roughly a third to a half of entry-level engineering pay at the same employer (Postman's own AmbitionBox page shows Software Engineer 0-5 yrs at Rs 29.7-39.9L) - do not benchmark a GTM offer against an engineering one. Glassdoor, 6figr and RepVue blocked direct fetching, so their numbers were read via search-engine result snippets citing the pages listed, not from the rendered pages themselves.

salary_benchmarks.family: Founder's office / chief of staff / strategy associate — entry-level (0-2 years), India (business-side, not engineering)

bands.note: This band is genuinely bimodal, so treat 4-11 as a range of two clusters, not a smooth distribution. Bottom cluster (bootstrapped / angel / tiny seed, often a glorified EA-plus-ops seat): AmbitionBox shows Founder's Office Associate 0-1 yr at Rs 3.3-3.7 L and Glassdoor has raw 2025-26 Bengaluru submissions at Rs 4 L and Rs 4-5 L flat. Top cluster (tier-1-VC or YC-backed seed hiring an IIT/IIM/SRCC-type grad): YC-backed Weekday's live Bengaluru Founder's Office posting is Rs 12-15 LPA cash + ESOPs, and 6figr has a verified Bengaluru 'Associate, Founder's Office' at 2 yrs with base 14.8 + stock 4.1 + bonus 0.7 = Rs 19.6 L CTC. Variable is usually zero or a token 5%; the real upside is ESOP, typically 0.02-0.10% of the cap table, 4-yr vest / 1-yr cliff. The Rs 16 L total-high assumes cash near the top of band plus a notional ESOP value of roughly 30-40% of cash (Xpheno/Business Standard put ESOP at 10-50% of the cash component for entry-to-mid startup roles); the single 19.6 L outlier sits above this band. If the offer is under Rs 6 L fixed at a metro seed startup, that is the low cluster, not the market.

Best-supported row in the table — four independent sources cluster here. Glassdoor's aggregate for 'Associate Founders Office' in India is base Rs 5-14 L, average Rs 10 L, plus ~Rs 1 L additional; the Bengaluru-specific 'Founders Office' page is base Rs 6-21 L, average Rs 13 L, plus Rs 1-4 L additional. AmbitionBox has Founder's Office Associate 1-3 yrs at Rs 8.0-8.9 L (32 salaries) and Business Strategy Associate 1-3 yrs at Rs 8.9-9.8 L (49 salaries). Beyond Campus's India guide states Rs 6-12 LPA for fresher Founder's Office roles at Series A-C. Raw Glassdoor 2026 submissions in the 1-3 yr bucket: Bengaluru Rs 11-13 L and Rs 14-16 L, New Delhi Rs 9-11 L and Rs 6 L, Mumbai Rs 10 L. Variable is typically 5-10% of fixed and often discretionary; ESOP grants of roughly 0.01-0.05% are standard at this stage. Rs 19 L total-high = ~14 L fixed + ~1 L bonus + ~4 L annualised notional ESOP. Anything at or above Rs 12 L fixed for a true 0-2 yr hire at Series A-B is a strong offer.

At Series C+ / late-stage / unicorn the seat is usually titled 'Associate - Founder's Office', 'Business Analyst - CEO's Office' or 'Strategy Associate' and is budgeted properly, so the floor rises and the ceiling is capped by internal levelling rather than founder discretion. Glassdoor company medians at this tier: Ditto Insurance Rs 12 L median for Associate Founder's Office and Rs 17 L median for Founder's Office; Jodo Rs 20 L median Founder's Office. Glassdoor 'Strategy Associate' India is base Rs 7-20 L, average Rs 11 L, plus Rs 1-4 L additional, with a raw Gurgaon 1-3 yr submission at Rs 15 L. LetsEnterprise's 2026 fresher guide puts unicorn/late-stage freshers at Rs 8-12 LPA generally. Variable moves to a formal 10-15% target; ESOPs are real but the grant percentage shrinks sharply (often 0.005-0.02%) even as the rupee value rises, and later-stage ESOPs carry a meaningful strike price. Rs 22 L total-high = ~16 L fixed + ~2 L bonus + ~4 L annualised ESOP. Caution: 6figr's Founder's Office page (avg Rs 32.1 L, 11 profiles) is NOT a valid entry-level benchmark — its sample is 3-9 yrs and includes Senior Associate/Program Lead titles (CashFlo Rs 33.1 L at 3 yrs, Everest Fleet Rs 35.5 L at 3.1 yrs), so I deliberately did not anchor on it.

The wide 8-20 spread is real and is driven entirely by hiring channel, not performance. Non-MBA / lateral UG hires land as 'Management Trainee - Strategy' or 'Analyst, CEO's Office': AmbitionBox Management Trainee is Rs 7.1-7.9 L at 0-1 yr and Rs 7.9-8.7 L at 1-3 yrs on a very robust 61.8k-salary sample, top 10% above Rs 14.9 L. Tier-1 MBA campus hires into corporate strategy / CoS-office pods sit far higher: AmbitionBox Strategy Analyst 1-3 yrs averages Rs 19 L (1.1k salaries) and Corporate Strategy Manager 1-3 yrs is Rs 15.9-21 L (506 salaries); AmbitionBox Strategy Associate averages Rs 18.8 L at 1 yr (232 salaries) though that number is inflated by MBB/Big-4 consulting associates and should be discounted for a corporate seat. Glassdoor Strategy Analyst India is base Rs 10-23.5 L, average Rs 19 L, plus Rs 2-5 L additional. Rs 26 L total-high = ~20 L fixed + 15-20% bonus + RSU/ESPP where listed. Note that a genuine titled 'Chief of Staff' at a listed company is an 8-18 yr role (Glassdoor India: base Rs 12-30 L, average Rs 20 L; Levels.fyi India median total comp Rs 46 L; PayScale early-career 1-4 yrs Rs 10.5 L on 19 profiles) — a 0-2 yr person is hired into the CoS office, not into the CoS title, so do not benchmark an entry offer against those senior numbers.

Extrapolated — this is the thinnest cell in the table and I am flagging it honestly. There is no role-and-stage-specific dataset for seed-stage founder's office hiring outside the big three metros; almost no seed company outside Bengaluru/Gurugram/Mumbai/Hyderabad/Pune budgets a dedicated founder's office seat at all, so the sample is a handful of submissions. What exists: a Glassdoor 2026 submission for Associate Founder's Office in Surat at 1-3 yrs is Rs 2-3 L; AmbitionBox's national Founder's Office Associate 0-1 yr figure of Rs 3.3-3.7 L is dragged down largely by non-metro and small-company entries; Internshala's fresher founder's-office/CoS listings for 2025-26 grads outside metros cluster at Rs 2.0-4.5 L (Jaipur Rs 2.53-4.56 L, Surat Rs 2.0-3.0 L, Ghaziabad Rs 2.0-3.5 L), with a Rs 2-8 L overall page range. I applied roughly a 30-40% haircut to the metro seed band, consistent with hire22's Tier-2/remote differential of -25% (their table is for senior CoS but the direction holds). The Rs 9 L total-high assumes a rare well-funded non-metro seed startup paying near Rs 7 L fixed plus token ESOP; ESOPs at non-metro seed companies are frequently promised verbally and never granted, so I would value them at zero when judging an offer here.

Partly extrapolated. 'Other Indian city' is not one market: Hyderabad and Pune behave almost like metros for this role, while Jaipur/Indore/Kochi/Kolkata/Coimbatore are 40-50% below. Glassdoor's Hyderabad 'Founders Office' page shows base Rs 11.5-26.5 L, average Rs 13 L (essentially at Bengaluru's Rs 13 L), but that is an all-experience page on a small sample, so I did not lift the entry band to match it. Supporting entry-level points: a Glassdoor 2026 Chief of Staff submission at 1-3 yrs in Kalyan is Rs 7-8 L; AmbitionBox's national Founder's Office Associate 1-3 yr band of Rs 8.0-8.9 L and Business Strategy Associate 1-3 yr band of Rs 8.9-9.8 L are national averages that include heavy non-metro weighting, which is why the top of my band sits near Rs 10 L. hire22's city table (Hyderabad +5%, Pune -5%, Chennai -8%, Tier-2/remote -25%) supports a 20-30% discount to the metro Series A-B band. If the offer is from a Hyderabad or Pune Series A-B company, judge it against the metro band minus ~15%, not against this row's floor. Total-high of Rs 13 L assumes ~10 L fixed plus small variable and a modest ESOP grant.

Extrapolated from the metro Series C+ band with a ~25% discount, cross-checked against national aggregates rather than city-and-stage-specific data — I could not find a dataset that isolates late-stage-startup founder's-office pay outside the top three metros, so treat this row as directional. Two things narrow the gap versus the seed and Series A-B non-metro rows: late-stage companies run national salary grids with only modest location factors (typically 10-20%, not 40%), and most of their non-metro founder's-office headcount sits in Hyderabad, Pune and Chennai rather than true tier-2 cities. Glassdoor's national 'Founders Office' aggregate (base Rs 6-18 L, average Rs 12 L, plus Rs 1-3 L additional) blends both tiers and its midpoint is consistent with this band's upper half. Rs 16 L total-high = ~12 L fixed + ~10% variable + ESOP that is real and liquid-ish at this stage. A genuinely remote-first Series C+ company will often pay the metro band regardless of where you sit — ask explicitly whether the company applies a location factor before accepting a discounted number.

The most defensible of the four non-metro rows, because listed and large companies use national pay grids with narrow location differentials and the underlying samples are large. AmbitionBox Management Trainee — the standard entry title for a CEO's-office/strategy support seat at a large Indian company — is Rs 7.1-7.9 L at 0-1 yr and Rs 7.9-8.7 L at 1-3 yrs on 61.8k salaries, and that figure is already national (i.e. non-metro-inclusive), which is why my floor is close to it rather than far below. Top 10% of Management Trainees exceed Rs 14.9 L, which sets the realistic ceiling for a strong non-metro entry offer. The upper half of the band (Rs 11-14 L) applies almost exclusively to tier-1 MBA campus hires posted to a Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai corporate office; AmbitionBox Corporate Strategy Manager at 1-3 yrs (Rs 15.9-21 L, 506 salaries) sits above this row and is a 3+ yr benchmark, not an entry one. Rs 18 L total-high = ~14 L fixed + 15% bonus + modest RSU/ESPP. Large listed employers also load more of the package into non-cash CTC components (PF, gratuity, insurance, LTA) than startups do, so compare fixed-cash-in-hand rather than headline CTC when weighing a listed offer against a startup one.

No aggregator tags company stage, so this row is built from small/early commerce employers that surface on AmbitionBox's Category Associate and Category Executive company tables as proxies: Squared Circle Ecom Rs 3.2-4.1L, Global Bees Rs 3.5-3.9L, Boodmo Rs 2.8-3.9L, Smytten Rs 5.1-5.9L, CityMall Rs 4.4-6.2L, Urban Company Rs 3.7-5.3L. The all-India Category Associate typical band is Rs 5.6-6.2L and Category Executive Rs 5-5.5L; a live Urban Company Category Manager posting on AmbitionBox for 1-4 yrs in Bengaluru quotes Rs 6-8.5L, which is roughly the ceiling a seed company pays a 0-2 yr hire. Titles here are 'Category Associate', 'Category Executive' or a founder's-office/category generalist role, not 'Category Manager'. Fixed_high of 9 assumes a tier-1 MBA or a strong lateral; the modal offer is Rs 5-6.5L. Total-comp high adds a 5-10% variable plus ESOP: junior grants in India run 0.05-0.1% of equity on a 4-year vest with a 1-year cliff, which on a USD 10-25M seed valuation is only about Rs 1-4L of paper per year and is worth nothing until an exit. Treat the ESOP component as optionality, not pay. Confidence is low because stage attribution is inferred from company identity rather than reported.

Weakest row in the table - I found no direct stage-tagged, city-tagged data for early-stage category hires outside the metros, so this is an extrapolation and should be read as such. It is anchored on three real things. First, the national floor titles: AmbitionBox Assistant Merchandiser typical Rs 3.2-3.5L (3.8k salaries) with 1-3 yrs top-10% at Rs 2.8-3.1L, and Merchandiser 1-3 yrs top-10% at Rs 3.3-3.7L - most non-metro early-stage category/merch work sits in this apparel-and-sourcing world, not the e-commerce world. Second, an observed non-metro discount: AmbitionBox shows Retail Merchandiser at Rs 3.4-4.5L in Kolkata against Rs 5.9-6.8L in Bengaluru, and Merchandiser at Rs 4.2-4.6L in Noida against Rs 4.9-5.4L in Gurugram. Third, general benchmarking guidance that tier-2 India runs roughly 15-25% below tier-1. ESOP at this stage in a non-metro seed company is usually token or absent, so total-comp high adds little over fixed. If an offer here clears Rs 6.5L fixed it is genuinely above market for the stage and city.

This is the widest-variance row and the one where an MBA label matters most. Anchors: AmbitionBox shows Zepto Category Manager at Rs 9.3-13.6L for 0-1 yr and Rs 10.1-13.7L for 1-3 yrs, and Wakefit Category Manager at Rs 12.8-14.2L across 0-6 yrs - both good markers for a well-funded growth-stage consumer company in a metro. At the lower end, CityMall Category Associate is Rs 4.4-6.2L and Smytten Category Executive Rs 5.1-5.9L. A 2026 e-commerce salary guide puts entry category management at Rs 8-14L in metros, and Storyboard18 (Jun 2025) reports quick-commerce non-tech roles at Rs 4-8L for operations associates with MBA category-management hires earning 15-25% more. Practically: a non-MBA graduate joining as Category Associate/Executive lands Rs 6-8L; a tier-1 MBA joining as Assistant Category Manager lands Rs 11-13L. Total-comp high of 18 assumes a 10% variable plus a real ESOP grant - at a USD 50-150M valuation a 0.05-0.1% junior grant is roughly Rs 2-8L of paper per year, and Series A-B is the stage where ESOP is genuinely a negotiating lever. Discount heavily if the ESOP has no buyback history.

Extrapolated, and flagged as such. Almost every Series A-B commerce category team in India is physically in Bengaluru, Gurugram or Mumbai; roles outside those cities at this stage are usually regional category/sourcing hybrids attached to a supply hub (Jaipur, Surat, Ludhiana, Coimbatore, Indore, Ahmedabad) rather than central category management, and they pay noticeably less. The band applies the observed non-metro discount to the Series A-B metro row: AmbitionBox shows Navi Mumbai Assistant Category Manager at Rs 8.4-9.9L against Bengaluru Rs 10.3-11.4L (about 18% lower) and Hyderabad Category Manager at Rs 12.1-13.5L against Bengaluru Rs 16.6-18.3L (about 27% lower). A 2026 e-commerce salary guide separately puts entry category management at Rs 6-11L in tier-2 against Rs 8-14L in metros, which brackets this row well for the 2-4 yr cohort and sits slightly above it for a true 0-2 yr hire. ESOP is usually offered but smaller than the metro equivalent. Confidence low: no source reports this stage-city cell directly.

Best-evidenced row, and the band is deliberately very wide because two different hiring tracks coexist inside the same companies. Track one, the MBA track titled 'Category Manager' from day one: AmbitionBox 1-3 yrs shows Flipkart Rs 22.1-24.4L, Meesho Rs 18-25.2L, Blinkit Rs 16.3-19.5L (1-7 yrs), Zepto Rs 10.1-13.7L. Track two, the non-MBA track titled 'Category Executive' or 'Category Associate': Blinkit Rs 4.7-6.4L, Swiggy Rs 4.1-4.9L, Myntra Rs 4-5.5L, Flipkart Rs 3.6-5.2L for 1-2 yrs. Assistant Category Manager sits between: Flipkart Rs 16-18.2L, Meesho Rs 11.3-15.5L, Swiggy Rs 11.4-14.2L, Eternal/Zomato Rs 10.4-13.1L. So the single most useful question about an offer in this cell is which track the title puts you on - the gap is 3-4x for the same years of experience. Fixed_high of 20 reflects a tier-1 MBA campus offer; total-comp high of 28 adds a 10-15% variable plus ESOP, which at this stage is a substantial and often liquid component (several of these companies run periodic buybacks). Sample sizes are large: 9.4k Category Manager salaries nationally, 700+ at Flipkart, 100+ each at Meesho and Zepto.

Directional city evidence is real but the stage split is inferred. AmbitionBox city bands for Category Manager: Bengaluru Rs 16.6-18.3L, Mumbai Rs 16.6-18.4L, Gurugram Rs 16.5-18.2L, New Delhi Rs 16.1-17.8L, but Hyderabad only Rs 12.1-13.5L - a 27% step down at the first non-NCR/Bengaluru/Mumbai metro. Indeed India (updated 31 Aug 2026, 59 salaries) shows the same gradient: Mumbai Rs 14.34L, Bengaluru Rs 13.66L, Delhi Rs 13.21L, Noida Rs 11.17L, Navi Mumbai Rs 10.34L, against a national average of Rs 10.69L and a 'Junior Category Manager' figure of Rs 7.71L. A 2026 e-commerce salary guide puts tier-2 entry category management at Rs 6-11L. Note that Series C+ commerce companies rarely run central category teams outside the big three cities - what exists in Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad or Kolkata is usually regional buying, supply or category-ops. ESOP is still granted and still real, hence the total-comp high, but grants are typically smaller than metro-HQ equivalents.

Also bimodal, and Amazon is a genuine outlier that stretches the top of the band. AmbitionBox shows Amazon Category Manager at Rs 29.4-36.8L for 1-3 yrs (300+ salaries) - that is an IIM/ISB campus hire number and includes RSUs and sign-on, so fixed base is closer to Rs 18-22L. Everything else clusters much lower: Reliance Retail Category Manager Rs 10.6-12.8L for 1-3 yrs (500+ salaries), PhonePe Category Analyst Rs 10.6-15.4L, Tata CLiQ Assistant Category Manager Rs 10.6-12.8L, BigBasket Rs 9.3-11L, Reliance Retail ACM Rs 9-11.2L, Croma Rs 8.4-10.2L, Nykaa ACM Rs 7.2-8L at 0-1 yr, Myntra ACM Rs 7.7-11.1L, DMart ACM Rs 5.7-6.9L. The floor is the executive track: Tata CLiQ Category Executive Rs 6.3-7.1L, Reliance Retail Rs 4.8-6.5L, Myntra Rs 4-5.5L for 1-2 yrs. Glassdoor's Bengaluru Category Manager page reports an average of about Rs 17.5L with a 25th percentile of Rs 11.95L and an entry point around Rs 6.5L - consistent, though I read those figures from the indexed summary because the page itself blocked direct fetch. Payscale India Assistant Category Manager (n=10, Feb 2025) shows base Rs 9L with bonus up to Rs 2.25L and early-career total Rs 6.9L; thin sample, used only as corroboration. Total-comp high of 34 assumes Amazon-style RSU plus sign-on; at a Reliance/Tata/DMart the variable is a 10-15% bonus and there is effectively no equity, so total lands within a lakh or two of fixed.

This is the cell where the apparel/retail buying-and-merchandising track dominates and pay is genuinely low, so do not benchmark it against e-commerce category numbers. AmbitionBox national bands: Merchandiser Rs 4.3-4.7L (17k salaries) with 1-3 yrs top-10% at only Rs 3.3-3.7L, Assistant Merchandiser Rs 3.2-3.5L with 1-3 yrs top-10% at Rs 2.8-3.1L, Retail Merchandiser Rs 4.4-4.9L with 1-3 yrs top-10% at Rs 3.6-4L, and Buyer 1-3 yrs top-10% at Rs 5.2-5.8L. City detail confirms the discount: Retail Merchandiser Kolkata Rs 3.4-4.5L, Merchandiser Noida Rs 4.2-4.6L. Large listed retailers do hire buying/merchandising management trainees across Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Lucknow, Coimbatore and Bhubaneswar, and those trainee CTCs are typically Rs 3.5-6L; the Rs 10L top of the band is reserved for a Reliance-Retail-style Assistant Category Manager posting (national 1-3 yr band Rs 10.6-12.8L for CM, Rs 9-11.2L for ACM) that happens to be based outside the big three cities. Indeed's Noida figure of Rs 11.17L and Navi Mumbai Rs 10.34L bracket that upper case. Listed employers grant no meaningful equity at this level, so total-comp high adds only a 10-15% performance bonus. Confidence is medium: the merchandising numbers are high-n and reliable, but the stage-city intersection for the category-management track specifically is thinly evidenced.

salary_benchmarks.family: Operations, supply chain and city launch (entry-level, 0-2 years, India)

bands.note: No aggregator segments India salary data by funding stage, so this row is triangulated, not measured. Anchors: Glassdoor India 'Founders Office Associate' avg Rs 8.28 LPA, 25th pct Rs 5.2 LPA, 75th pct Rs 13.5 LPA (n=6 only - very weak); frontlinesmedia's 2026 SCM guide puts entry supply-chain analysts at startups at Rs 3-5 LPA 'sometimes with ESOPs'; AmbitionBox Operations Associate metro medians are Rs 3.9-4.4 LPA (Bengaluru 4.0-4.4, Mumbai 3.9-4.3). Realistic seed offer for a 0-2y ops / city-launch generalist in a metro is Rs 5-7 LPA fixed; Rs 9 LPA is the ceiling and effectively requires a tier-1 MBA or IIT/BITS/SRCC-type hire into a well-funded pre-A team. Variable pay is usually nil at this stage. ESOP is real but illiquid: junior grants run 0.05-0.1 percent of the cap table, so total_high assumes roughly Rs 2-3 LPA of annualised paper value at a Rs 80-150 Cr valuation. When judging an actual offer, value the ESOP at zero and negotiate on fixed.

Weakest cell in the table - I found no direct dataset for seed-stage ops hires outside metros, so this is the metro seed band discounted for city. Discount evidence: AmbitionBox Operations Associate Kolkata Rs 3.2-3.5 vs Bengaluru Rs 4.0-4.4 (-20 pct), Coimbatore supply-chain analyst Rs 4.8-6.0 vs Bengaluru Rs 7.0-7.7 (-30 pct); salary.com logistics ops manager Indore -14.5 pct, Lucknow -12.4 pct, Jaipur -9.2 pct vs national. frontlinesmedia puts tier-2 entry supply-chain analysts at Rs 3.5-4.5 LPA. PayScale early-career Operations Associate India avg is Rs 3.10 LPA, which is where the national (non-metro-weighted) mass sits. Most seed startups outside metros hire ops for Rs 3-4.5 LPA; Rs 6 LPA implies a genuinely central/analytical role, not a hub or field role. ESOP typically token or absent.

This band is genuinely bimodal and you must place your offer in the right half. Field / hub / city-ops execution roles: Rs 3.5-6 LPA - AmbitionBox shows Porter 'Business Associate' at 1-2 yrs Rs 4.5-4.8 LPA and Rapido 'Business Operations Executive' Rs 2.4-4.5 LPA (n=42) even at later stage, and Series A-B firms pay at or slightly below that. Central ops / supply-chain analyst / city-launch roles hired off tier-1 campuses or from a consulting/analyst background: Rs 8-12 LPA - AmbitionBox Operations Analyst India is Rs 5.3-5.9 LPA rising to Rs 6.8-7.6, and requirehire's 2026 guide puts MBA entry into ops at Rs 10-14 LPA. Rs 12 LPA fixed at Series A-B is a strong offer and usually means the role owns a P&L or a city launch. Variable is typically 5-10 pct and often milestone-linked; ESOP is normal here and a junior grant carries roughly Rs 2-4 LPA/yr of paper value at a Rs 300-800 Cr valuation, which is what takes total_high to 16.

Extrapolated: I could not find any stage-tagged, non-metro entry-level ops dataset. Built by applying the observed 15-30 pct tier-2 discount (AmbitionBox Coimbatore supply-chain analyst Rs 4.8-6.0 vs Bengaluru Rs 7.0-7.7; Kolkata ops associate Rs 3.2-3.5 vs Bengaluru Rs 4.0-4.4; salary.com Indore -14.5 pct) to the Series A-B metro band. In practice most Series A-B roles outside the big three cities are cluster/hub/city-expansion roles at Rs 3-5.5 LPA; Rs 7-8 LPA only appears where the company is launching that city and the hire owns it end-to-end, and such hires are often relocated from a metro on metro-ish pay. ESOP present but smaller grants; variable often replaced by a launch/route-density bonus.

Best-evidenced row, and the widest, because Series C+ quick-commerce and logistics firms run two totally separate entry ladders. Ladder 1, dark-store / hub / linehaul / field ops (verified AmbitionBox company data): Zepto 'DH Operations Executive' 0-1 yr Rs 2.8-3.7 LPA; Zepto 'Executive - Linehaul Operation' 0-3 yrs Rs 2.9-3.4 LPA; Zepto 'Team Lead - Deputy Delivery Hub Manager' 1-5 yrs Rs 4.4-4.9 LPA; Rapido Business Ops Executive Rs 2.4-4.5 LPA (n=42); Udaan Operations Executive Rs 1.6-4.2 LPA (n=413); Zomato 'Customer Delight Associate' 0-2 yrs Rs 4.0-5.5 LPA. Ladder 2, central ops / category ops / supply-chain analyst / city launch, hired off tier-1 campuses: edifyedu's 2026 MBA-ops guide reports fresher dark-store operations managers at Rs 8-14 LPA and e-commerce ops entry at Rs 7-12 LPA; AmbitionBox India-wide Supply Chain Analyst is Rs 7.3-8.1 LPA (Bengaluru Rs 7.0-7.7) and City Manager Rs 7.6-8.4 LPA at ~4 yrs, with the entry bucket Rs 6.1-6.8. If your offer is a hub/store role, judge it against Rs 3-5.5; if it is a central or city-launch role, against Rs 8-14. Variable at this stage is typically 10-20 pct and ESOP is standard, adding roughly Rs 3-4 LPA/yr of paper value at the top of the band.

Series C+ firms are the ones actually hiring ops at scale outside the big three, so there is real data. Udaan Operations Executive Rs 1.6-4.2 LPA (n=413) and Zepto's hub/linehaul executive bands Rs 2.8-3.7 LPA are heavily tier-2/tier-3 weighted, which is why the floor here is Rs 2.6 rather than Rs 3.0. AmbitionBox non-metro ops-associate medians: Kolkata Rs 3.2-3.5, Chennai Rs 3.3-3.6, Pune Rs 3.3-3.6, Noida Rs 3.5-3.8; Coimbatore supply-chain analyst Rs 4.8-6.0. Indeed India puts Operations Associate at Rs 3.97 LPA average with a Rs 1.77-8.89 LPA spread. The Rs 9 LPA top end is a cluster-manager or city-launch owner covering a whole tier-2 market, typically a tier-1 campus hire posted out of a metro. Variable 10-15 pct is common (fill-rate, SLA, cost-per-order linked); ESOP grants exist but are smaller than for metro central-ops peers.

Again two ladders. Direct-hire executive roles at listed operators are low and well-measured: Delhivery 'Executive' Rs 2.0-4.3 LPA (n=1597), Swiggy 'Assistant Store Manager' Rs 2.0-4.5 LPA (n=663), Zomato 'Associate' Rs 3.4-7.5 LPA (n=388); AmbitionBox India-wide Operations Executive is only Rs 3.2-3.5 LPA and Glassdoor India puts it at Rs 3.17 LPA, confirming the floor. upGrad's Swiggy breakdown gives a 'Customer Success, Service and Operations' department average of Rs 5.4 LPA and 'Procurement and Supply Chain' Rs 7.3 LPA across all tenures. The high end is the structured graduate/MT programme: AmbitionBox Supply Chain Analyst India Rs 7.3-8.1 LPA, frontlinesmedia puts large-MNC entry supply-chain analysts at Rs 6-8 LPA, eicta/IITK puts entry ops manager at Rs 5-10 LPA, and FMCG flagship programmes sit above all of these - Unilever's India Future Leaders Programme is advertised at Rs 56,000-1,50,000 per month depending on stage, i.e. roughly Rs 14-18 LPA at the top. Rs 14 LPA fixed is therefore an FMCG-MT or Amazon/Flipkart ops-manager-grade offer, not a typical one. total_high 20 assumes 10-20 pct bonus plus RSUs, which at listed firms (Swiggy, Zomato/Eternal, Delhivery, Amazon) are liquid and should be counted at face value, unlike private-startup ESOPs.

Large logistics and retail operators run most of their warehouse, sortation-centre and last-mile network outside the big three, so the volume of entry-level ops jobs here is enormous and the pay is compressed. AmbitionBox India-wide Operations Executive Rs 3.2-3.5 LPA (Mumbai only Rs 3.1-3.4, so this title carries almost no metro premium); Delhivery 'Executive' Rs 2.0-4.3 LPA across a 1597-salary sample that is largely non-metro; Indeed India puts the adjacent Operations Administrator title at Rs 2.21 LPA average. frontlinesmedia's tier-2 entry supply-chain analyst band is Rs 3.5-4.5 LPA and its logistics-coordinator band Rs 2.5-4.5 LPA. salary.com shows logistics ops manager pay 9-15 pct below national in Jaipur, Lucknow and Indore. The Rs 9 LPA top end is an MT-programme posting or a plant/DC supply-chain analyst at an FMCG or 3PL, not a standard hub role. Variable is usually a modest SLA/productivity bonus; listed-company RSUs at this level are small or absent, which is why total_high sits only ~3 LPA above fixed_high.

Anchors: AmbitionBox Growth Marketing Executive (n=158, updated 2026-08-22) shows 0-1 yr typical 4.32-4.78L and 1-2 yr typical 4.46-4.93L, all-experience median 5.0L / p75 6.92L. Glassdoor India 'Growth Associate' shows total 4-7L, avg base 6L, avg additional pay 1L (range 0.5-2L); Stanza Living median 5L. Glassdoor Bengaluru 'Growth Marketing Associate' total 4-10.8L with the associate rung of its own ladder at 4-7L; one employer-provided Bengaluru posting at 6L flat. Variable at this stage is usually a token 0.5-1L ad-spend/ROAS bonus, often unpaid. ESOP is common but small for a 0-2 yr hire (roughly 0.01-0.05%) and illiquid, so total_high adds only ~2L of notional paper value over fixed. Confidence capped at medium because NONE of the consulted sources tag funding stage - the stage split is inferred from company names inside the datasets (e.g. Zouk 4.8-6.1L at 0-1 yrs, Wiingy 4.2-7.5L, Prohash 4.5-5.0L on the AmbitionBox company-wise table).

Extrapolated, not directly measured - no source I could reach reports seed-stage pay by city. Method: took the metro seed band and applied the city gradient AmbitionBox publishes for comparable entry titles. AmbitionBox Marketing Associate city averages: Bengaluru typical 5.72-6.32L, Delhi 5.99-6.62L, Mumbai 5.46-6.04L, Gurugram 5.59-6.17L vs Pune 5.35-5.97L, Hyderabad 4.03-4.61L, Noida 4.75-5.36L, Kolkata 3.80-4.57L. AmbitionBox Digital Marketing Executive (n=47,885) 0-1 yr typical 2.50-2.77L nationally, with Pune 3.16-3.50L and Hyderabad 3.32-3.67L vs Bengaluru 3.65-4.03L. Glassdoor employer-provided listings for growth/performance marketing executive show 20-30K/month (2.4-3.6L) at the low end. Net gradient applied: about 25-30% below the metro band. In Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai and Ahmedabad the real number sits at the top of this band; in Indore, Jaipur, Kochi and Kolkata at the bottom. ESOP at a non-metro seed startup is frequently absent entirely.

This is where the title flips from 'executive' to 'analyst/associate' and pay steps up sharply. AmbitionBox Growth Analyst (n=197, updated 2026-08-21): 0-1 yr n=23 avg 9.59L typical 8.11-11.07L; 1-2 yr n=57 avg 8.57L typical 7.41-9.72L; Bengaluru avg 11.77L (typical 9.77-13.77L); p10 4.5L and p25 5.5L set the floor. Company rows in that dataset at 0-2 yrs experience: ShopDeck 5.8-9.0L, Apollo 247 6.5-10.5L, WebEngage 5.0-7.0L. Glassdoor Bengaluru Growth Marketing Associate: avg base 7L, total range 4-10.8L, avg additional pay 90K (range 60K-1L). Top of band is real: 6figr carries a verified Uni Cards Bengaluru 'Growth Marketing Analyst (L1)' at 1.0 yrs on 13.9L base + 1.0L bonus = 14.9L CTC. Variable is typically 8-12% and tied to CAC/ROAS; ESOP grants become structured here (roughly 0.02-0.1%, 4-yr vest, 1-yr cliff), worth about 1-3L/yr on paper - that plus variable is the gap from 11L fixed to 14L total. Medium not high: the title-level numbers agree across three independent sources, but the stage attribution is my inference.

Extrapolated. AmbitionBox publishes a Growth Analyst city breakout for Bengaluru only (avg 11.77L) - it has no non-metro city with enough datapoints, which is itself the finding: Series A-B growth hiring is overwhelmingly metro. Gradient sources used: AmbitionBox Marketing Associate Hyderabad 4.03-4.61L vs Bengaluru 5.72-6.32L (about -30%); Levels.fyi India Marketing city medians Bengaluru 19.83L, Mumbai 13.79L, Gurgaon 11.56L, Hyderabad 9.03L (all-levels, big-tech-skewed, so use the ratio not the level); Skilletal's growth-role city split puts Chennai/Hyderabad at about 10L and Pune/Ahmedabad about 8L where BLR/MUM/NCR is 13-15L for the manager rung, i.e. a 30-45% discount. Applied about -27% to the metro Series A-B band. Treat this row as a planning estimate, not a measurement. A remote-first Series A startup paying a Pune-based hire will often pay the metro band instead.

Bimodal - read the note before using the band. Non-MBA lateral entry: AmbitionBox Growth Analyst Bengaluru typical 9.77-13.77L, median 10.83L, p75 11.0L; company rows Minimalist 8.0-15.0L (2-3 yrs), Bright Money 13.0-15.0L (2-6 yrs); AmbitionBox Marketing Associate company rows Meesho 4.8-11.0L avg 7.8L, Innovaccer 5.0-10.0L avg 8.2L; Glassdoor lists Innovaccer Growth Marketing Associate Bangalore at 9L median. Tier-1 MBA campus entry into the same growth teams is a separate, higher track that this band's top reflects: 6figr carries Camp K12 Gurugram Performance Marketing Manager at 1.9 yrs on 12.1L, and Paytm Mall Noida growth marketing at 2.4 yrs (IIM) on 22.3L CTC; AmbitionBox Growth Marketing Manager (the next rung, 2-3 yrs) is already at typical 12.38-15.76L. If the offer is a campus MBA growth role, judge it against 16-24L, not this row. Variable 10-15% is standard at this stage and ESOP is meaningful (roughly 0.01-0.05% but on a large valuation, plus periodic buybacks at Razorpay/Meesho/Swiggy-tier companies), worth about 2-5L/yr - that is the 15L fixed to 21L total gap.

Extrapolated. Late-stage startups concentrate growth teams in Bengaluru, Gurugram and Mumbai; what exists elsewhere is mostly satellite or shared-services marketing in Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai and Noida, which pays materially less. AmbitionBox Marketing Associate: Hyderabad typical 4.03-4.61L and Noida 4.75-5.36L vs Bengaluru 5.72-6.32L. Levels.fyi India Marketing (all levels) medians: Hyderabad 9.03L vs Bengaluru 19.83L - a 2.2x gap, though much of that is company mix rather than pure location. AmbitionBox Digital Marketing Executive Pune 3.16-3.50L vs Bengaluru 3.65-4.03L is a much narrower 12% gap at the true-entry rung, so I weighted toward the smaller discount and applied about -27% to the metro Series C+ band. No source I reached reports late-stage-startup growth pay for a specific non-metro city, so this row is inference. ESOP is usually granted on the same policy as metro hires, which is why total_high stays 3L above fixed_high.

The widest band of the eight, because listed and large companies run two entirely separate entry doors into the same growth function. Executive/non-MBA door: AmbitionBox Swiggy 'Growth Marketing Executive' n=4 at 1-2 yrs, 3.6-8.14L (avg 4.65L); Swiggy 'Digital Marketing Executive' n=10 at 2-3 yrs, 3.65-5.0L; Nykaa 'Growth Marketing Executive' n=2 at 2-3 yrs, 8.46-10.81L. Campus/MBA and analyst door: Levels.fyi India Marketing p25 is 9.38L against a 16.44L all-levels median (updated 2026-09-10), and Levels.fyi Entry Level Marketing Operations India is median 4.38L / p75 6.71L / p90 9.25L; AmbitionBox Growth Marketing Manager company rows show Bharti Airtel starting at minExp 0 with a 18.9L floor and Bajaj Finserv at minExp 1 with an 11.22L floor, i.e. campus intake lands well above the executive rung. Glassdoor India Growth Marketing Manager 8-20L, avg base 14.3L, avg additional pay 2L. Variable is a real 10-20% here and equity is RSU-style and liquid at Eternal/Zomato, Swiggy, Nykaa, Paytm, Policybazaar, Info Edge, Flipkart, Amazon and Google - that liquidity is why total_high (22L) sits 7L above fixed_high, a bigger gap than any startup row.

Partly measured, partly extrapolated. The measured part is the large-employer floor, which is well sampled outside the metros: AmbitionBox Marketing Executive (n=55,138, updated 2026-09-09) 0-1 yr typical 3.12-3.45L and 1-2 yr 3.22-3.56L nationally, and Digital Marketing Executive (n=47,885) 0-1 yr 2.50-2.77L - these are dominated by agencies, IT services and traditional large corporates, and they set the true bottom of what a large employer pays a 0-2 yr marketer in a tier-2 city. The extrapolated part is the upper half: AmbitionBox Marketing Associate Chennai 5.21-5.97L, Ahmedabad 5.21-6.21L, Hyderabad 4.03-4.61L; Levels.fyi India Marketing Hyderabad median 9.03L (all levels). I set fixed_low at 4.5 rather than 3.0 because a genuine growth or performance marketing brief, as opposed to a generic marketing executive job, does not get filled at 3L even in a tier-2 city. Total_high 13L assumes a 10-15% variable plus a modest RSU grant; many large non-tech employers outside the metros grant no equity at all to a 0-2 yr hire, in which case treat 10-11L as the ceiling.

salary_benchmarks.family: Business analyst and data analyst (entry-level, 0-2 years, India)

bands.note: Widest band of the eight, and the spread is real, not noise. The single biggest driver is TITLE, not stage or city: at the same large company a 'Business Analyst' is a premium campus hire and a 'Data Analyst' is an ops/reporting role paid 2-3x less. AmbitionBox 0-1 yr avg bands, Sep 2026: Flipkart BA 11.2-16.7 (25 reports) vs Flipkart DA 4.5-5.0 (105 reports); Amazon BA 10.7-13.6 (71) vs Amazon DA 1-3yr 8.9-9.9 (563); Swiggy BA 10.9-15.0 vs Swiggy DA 4.0-5.8; Eternal/Zomato DA 5.7-8.0. Bottom of the band is IT-services/GCC 'analyst' intake in the same cities: TCS DA 4.1-4.6, Infosys DA 3.7-4.1, Accenture DA 5.7-6.3, Accenture BA 8.9-9.8. Paytm sits mid-band (BA 0-1: 5.7-8.3). Total-comp high of 22 assumes 10-15% variable plus RSUs, which at Amazon/Flipkart/Groww-class employers are liquid or near-liquid, unlike private-startup ESOP. Corroborated across three independent sources: Indeed India base averages (BA Bengaluru 10.26L, Mumbai 9.21L, Gurgaon 8.87L; DA Gurgaon 8.20L, Bengaluru 7.82L) and Levels.fyi India p25 (BA 10.64L, DA 9.28L, big-tech skewed).

'Other Indian city' splits into two very different sub-markets and you must know which one an offer is in. Pune, Hyderabad and Chennai are GCC hubs and price near-metro: AmbitionBox 1-3yr Pune BA 7.3-8.0 vs Bengaluru 7.9-8.7 (only ~8% below); Indeed Hyderabad BA 8.82L, Pune 8.96L. True tier-2 is far lower: Indeed India Sep 2026 all-experience base averages are BA Ahmedabad 6.90L, Kolkata 5.95L, Indore 5.65L, Kochi 5.46L, Jaipur 5.43L, Chandigarh 5.41L, Coimbatore 4.85L (median ~5.5L), and DA Jaipur 6.06L, Ahmedabad 4.59L, Kochi 4.44L, Kolkata 4.09L, Indore 3.89L, Coimbatore 3.69L, Chandigarh 2.98L (median ~4.1L) - a 35-45% discount to metro, and those are all-experience figures, so an entry-level offer sits below them. Bottom of the band is IT-services fresher intake (Infosys DA 3.7-4.1, TCS DA 4.1-4.6, both largely Pune/Chennai/Hyderabad/Kolkata headcount). Top of band (13) is a Hyderabad/Pune GCC or captive analytics team hiring a premium-campus BA. Medium not high because Indeed's tier-2 samples are thin (3-18 reports per city) and AmbitionBox publishes no tier-2 location pages for these two titles.

Built from four late-stage private companies' own AmbitionBox pages rather than any stage-tagged aggregator (none exists for India). AmbitionBox Sep 2026, 0-1yr / 1-3yr avg bands: Meesho BA 13.4-15.7 (31 reports) / 14.6-16.1 (195); PhonePe BA 10.2-15.1 (8) / 13.3-16.0 (55); Razorpay DA 7.5-11.2 (4) / 8.4-10.9 (28); PhonePe DA 9.9-11.8; Meesho DA 4.8-6.5 (13) / 5.2-6.3 (39); CRED DA 3.8-5.5 (5, thin). Same title split as listed/large - the BA population clusters 13-16 and the DA population 5-11 - so where an offer lands in this band depends almost entirely on whether the role is a strategy/category BA or a dashboards-and-SQL DA. Total-comp high of 24 assumes ~10-15% variable plus a genuine ESOP grant, which at Series C+ is typically 3-8 LPA of notional value per year over a 4-year vest with a plausible buyback path; several Indian Series C+ firms now run periodic buybacks, so discount that less than at seed but do not treat it as cash. Medium rather than high: all the stage-specific evidence comes from one aggregator, and the DA samples per company are small. Cutshort (startup-skewed) showing an all-experience DA average of 11.5 LPA supports the upper half.

Extrapolated, not observed - flagging that honestly. No source I could reach segments late-stage Indian startups by non-metro location for these titles, because Series C+ Indian startups concentrate their business and analytics teams in Bengaluru, Gurugram and Mumbai; a non-metro posting from one is usually an ops/city-analytics seat, which prices lower than the same title at HQ. Derived by applying the 35-45% metro-to-tier-2 discount visible in Indeed's city data to the Series C+ metro row, then floored by AmbitionBox Pune 1-3yr bands (BA 7.3-8.0, DA 5.4-6.0) since Pune/Hyderabad/Chennai behave as near-metro. Only direct evidence at this stage-city cell is a live Wellfound listing: Loyalty Juggernaut (growth stage, 201-500 employees), BI Analyst, Hyderabad, 1 year of experience, INR 8-10L, no equity. Treat this row as a sanity check on an offer rather than a benchmark, and if the offer is in Pune/Hyderabad/Chennai use the Series C+ metro row discounted ~10% instead.

Anchored on the AmbitionBox metro market rate for 1-3 years, which is what a Series A-B startup has to beat to hire: BA Bengaluru 7.9-8.7, Gurugram 8.0-8.8, Mumbai 7.6-8.4; DA Bengaluru 5.8-6.4, Gurugram 6.1-6.7, Mumbai 5.6-6.2 (Sep 2026, 4-18k reports per city-band). Series A-B firms with fresh capital typically pay at or slightly above that on fixed for a business/strategy analyst (10-13 for a premium-campus hire into a founder's-office or growth-analyst seat) and at or slightly below it for a pure DA seat (5-8), then close the gap with ESOP. Live Wellfound India listings in this cohort span INR 8-10L (growth-stage BI Analyst, 1 yr) up to genuine outliers like INR 20-30L plus 5-10% equity (Velocity, Bengaluru, 2 yrs) which look mispriced or mislabelled - do not anchor on those. Total high of 19 assumes ~10% variable (entry-level Indian variable is typically 5-15% of CTC) plus 2-5 LPA/yr of notional ESOP. Medium, not high: this row is triangulated from city market rate plus job postings, because no Indian source segments salary by Series A vs Series B.

Thinnest cell in the table alongside seed/non-metro. Nothing I could reach reports Series A-B compensation by non-metro city for these titles. Constructed by taking the Indeed tier-2 all-experience city averages (BA median ~5.5L, DA median ~4.1L across Ahmedabad, Indore, Jaipur, Kochi, Chandigarh, Coimbatore, Kolkata) and adjusting down for 0-2 years, then cross-checked against PayScale India entry-level base medians (DA 4.13L with p10 2.04L / p90 8.17L, 1,213 profiles; BA-IT 4.58L with p10 2.46L / p90 8.41L, 218 profiles) - though note PayScale's entry-level India pages were last refreshed Oct 2024 and Jan 2025 respectively, so they understate 2026 by roughly a year of increments. Upper end of 8 applies to Pune/Hyderabad, which price near-metro. ESOP at this stage in a non-metro office is usually a token grant, so total high is only ~3 LPA above fixed high.

No salary aggregator covers pre-Series A Indian companies - they are too small and too new to accumulate self-reported salaries - so this row is built from live job postings plus the market floor. Direct evidence from Wellfound India listings tagged 'Early Stage - startup in initial stages' (Sep 2026): Bitkraft, Business Analyst - AI, Mumbai, 0 years of experience, INR 2.4-6L; TopGrep Tech, Junior Power BI Developer/Analyst, Bengaluru, 1 year, INR 3.5-4.5L; and a growth-stage Junior Project Analyst at INR 2-3L. That is the genuine floor. The top of the band (11) is the well-funded seed startup hiring an ex-consulting or premium-campus 'founder's office / business analyst', which does clear 10L fixed in Bengaluru and Gurugram but is a small slice of the postings. Cross-checked against AmbitionBox India-wide DA 0-1yr 3.5-5.2 and PayScale entry-level medians (DA 4.13L, BA-IT 4.58L). Total high of 15 is mostly notional ESOP: at seed there is usually little or no variable, and the equity is paper at a valuation with no liquidity path, so discount it heavily rather than treating the gap between 11 and 15 as pay. Low confidence and I would not use this row to reject an offer on its own.

Weakest cell in the table - say so plainly to anyone using this. There is no dataset for pre-Series A companies in non-metro India; I am extrapolating from two things. First, the Indeed tier-2 floor: DA all-experience base averages of INR 2.98L (Chandigarh), 3.69L (Coimbatore), 3.89L (Indore), 4.09L (Kolkata), 4.44L (Kochi), and BA 4.85L (Coimbatore), 5.41L (Chandigarh), 5.43L (Jaipur) - and an entry-level seed-stage offer sits at or below those all-experience means. Second, PayScale's India entry-level DA p10 of INR 2.04L base, which is where the genuine bottom of this market is. Wellfound early-stage postings at INR 2-3L for junior analyst work confirm sub-3L offers are real, not typos. ESOP at a non-metro seed company is effectively worthless for benchmarking purposes and variable is rare, so total high is only ~2 LPA above fixed high. Also note: Glassdoor India, 6figr, Instahyre and the Michael Page 2026 India Salary Guide all refused automated access or are login-gated, so none of them fed any row in this table.
